SELECT t.tradereg, 
       COUNT(tr.transreg) AS total_txns,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.corpeventprx IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS corp_event_txns,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.corpeventprx IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numeric) / COUNT(tr.transreg) AS pct_corp_event
FROM trader t
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
LEFT JOIN sentimentandfundamentals s ON s.transref = tr.transreg
GROUP BY t.tradereg
HAVING CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.corpeventprx IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numeric) / COUNT(tr.transreg) > 0.3
LIMIT 5;
SELECT AVG(ABS(newsscore - socscore)) AS avg_sdf, MAX(ABS(newsscore - socscore)) AS max_sdf FROM sentimentandfundamentals;

-- Step 1: Find Event-Driven Traders (>30% of transactions have non-null corpeventprx)
WITH event_driven AS (
    SELECT t.tradereg
    FROM trader t
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    LEFT JOIN sentimentandfundamentals s ON s.transref = tr.transreg
    GROUP BY t.tradereg
    HAVING CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.corpeventprx IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numeric) / COUNT(tr.transreg) > 0.3
),
-- Step 2: Find Aggressive Event Speculators (Event-Driven AND risklevel = 'Aggressive')
aggressive_event_spec AS (
    SELECT ed.tradereg
    FROM event_driven ed
    JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = ed.tradereg
    WHERE t.trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'risklevel' = 'Aggressive'
),
-- Step 3: Find Volatile Event Speculators (Aggressive Event Spec AND SDF > 1.0)
volatile_event_spec AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT aes.tradereg
    FROM aggressive_event_spec aes
    JOIN sentimentandfundamentals s ON s.trdref2 = aes.tradereg
    WHERE ABS(s.newsscore - s.socscore) > 1.0
)
-- Step 4: Calculate average OMI for volatile event speculators
SELECT AVG(CAST(tr.modfreq AS numeric) / (1 - tr.cancelpct)) AS avg_omi
FROM volatile_event_spec ves
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.trdref = ves.tradereg;
